title: Split the dinner bill
situation: Six friends ate out; one paid ₹4,800. Chasing the other five on WhatsApp is awkward and someone always forgets.
build: An agent that splits the bill, sends each friend a UPI collect request and reminds them once a day until they pay.
kill_test: Kill it after 3 of the 5 requests are sent.
must_hold: Every friend gets exactly one request. Reminders carry on from where they were.

title: Rent day at a PG
situation: A PG owner collects rent from 40 tenants on the 5th of every month, by hand, from a notebook.
build: An agent that charges every tenant, sends a receipt and marks the month paid.
kill_test: Kill it halfway down the tenant list.
must_hold: 40 charges, 40 receipts. Nobody is charged twice, nobody is skipped.

title: Salary day at a 30-person startup
situation: Payroll runs as one bulk bank transfer plus 30 payslip emails. If it dies halfway, finance has to work out who got paid.
build: A payroll agent: compute pay, transfer, email payslips, write a payroll register.
kill_test: Kill it after the bank accepted the transfers but before the payslips go out.
must_hold: Each person paid once and gets one payslip. The register shows every step.

title: Money debited, not received
situation: A customer's UPI payment is debited, but the shop never got it. The bank settles it by T+1: reversed or success.
build: A support agent that checks the payment status, waits for the bank, then either confirms the order or tells the customer it reversed.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the bank. Restart it.
must_hold: It comes back still waiting. It never refunds money that's still pending.

title: EMI bounce handler
situation: An NBFC's EMI auto-debit bounced. Rules say: retry on the 10th and 15th, notify the customer, hand over to a collections officer after 3 failures.
build: An agent that runs that schedule for each loan.
kill_test: Kill it between two retries, and once again right after a retry.
must_hold: Retries happen only on the scheduled dates, never because the agent restarted.

title: Monthly chit fund
situation: A 20-member chit fund collects every month, draws a winner and pays out. Members argue when the draw looks redone.
build: An agent that collects, draws, pays out and publishes the result.
kill_test: Kill it after the draw and before the payout.
must_hold: The winner never changes on restart. One payout per month.

title: Bank credits vs invoices
situation: A shop gets 500 bank credits a day and has to match each to an invoice for GST. Narrations are messy.
build: An agent that matches credits to invoices (LLM for the fuzzy ones) and sends unclear ones to the accountant to confirm.
kill_test: Kill it mid-batch, and again while the accountant is reviewing.
must_hold: Each credit matched once. Pending reviews survive. Paid-for LLM calls aren't repeated.

title: Refund desk with limits
situation: An online store: refunds up to ₹2,000 are automatic, above that a manager approves, and managers take days.
build: A refund agent with that rule.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the manager, then again right after the refund call.
must_hold: One refund per order. The approval wait survives restarts.

title: Festival cashback
situation: Diwali offer: the first 1,000 UPI payments above ₹500 get ₹50 cashback.
build: An agent that watches payments and pays the cashback.
must_hold: Exactly 1,000 cashbacks. Nobody gets two.

title: Expense claims
situation: Employees upload bills; a manager approves; finance pays. Claims get lost in email.
build: An agent that reads the bill, fills the claim, waits for the manager, then pays.
kill_test: Kill it while the claim waits for approval.
must_hold: The claim is still waiting after the restart. Paid once.

title: Chai shop, plus delivery
situation: The chai agent from the talk now also books a delivery rider.
build: Start from the chai repo (chai/) and add a book_rider step.
kill_test: Kill it after the charge, and again after the rider is booked.
must_hold: Payments 1, kitchen tickets 1, riders 1.

title: Cloud kitchen router
situation: Orders arrive on WhatsApp. Three kitchens, different stock. Whichever has it cooks it; then a rider is booked.
build: An agent that checks stock, routes the order, books a rider.
kill_test: Kill it after a kitchen accepted and before the rider is booked.
must_hold: One kitchen cooks, one rider comes.

title: Sold out after payment
situation: The customer paid, then the item ran out. Do you refund, wait or swap?
build: An agent that asks the customer (wait / swap / refund) and refunds by default after 30 minutes.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the customer.
must_hold: Still waiting after restart. The timeout still fires on time. One refund at most.

title: Kirana restock
situation: A kirana owner photographs empty shelves at night. The distributor takes orders in the morning.
build: An agent that drafts the order from the photo and sends it once the owner says yes.
kill_test: Kill it overnight while it waits for the owner.
must_hold: One order to the distributor, only after a yes.

title: 300 Diwali hampers
situation: A company sends hampers to 300 employees' homes.
build: An agent that books 300 shipments and reports what went out.
must_hold: 300 shipments, none doubled, a report of all 300.

title: Table booking with a deposit
situation: A restaurant takes ₹500 deposits, reminds guests 2 hours before, and releases no-show tables.
build: An agent that books, charges the deposit, reminds and releases.
kill_test: Kill it between the booking and the reminder.
must_hold: The reminder still goes out on time, once.

title: Abandoned cart
situation: A D2C brand sends 3 reminders over 3 days to people who left items in the cart.
build: An agent that sends them and stops the moment the customer buys.
must_hold: No reminder twice. None after a purchase.

title: Returns and refunds
situation: A return goes: book pickup, item reaches the warehouse, QC takes 2–3 days, then refund or reject.
build: An agent that runs that flow per return.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for QC.
must_hold: Still waiting after restart. Refund once, only after QC passes.

title: Flash sale: 100 units
situation: 100 units, 10,000 buyers in a minute. Reservations expire if not paid in 10 minutes.
build: An agent (or several workers) that reserves, charges and confirms.
kill_test: Kill workers at random during the sale.
must_hold: Never sell 101. Nobody is charged without an order.

title: Price update everywhere
situation: A restaurant changes prices. They must change on two delivery apps and its own website.
build: An agent that updates all three (mock them) and logs who changed what.
kill_test: Kill it after the first app is updated.
must_hold: All three updated, each once. The log shows every change.

title: Tatkal at 10:00
situation: Tatkal opens at 10:00 sharp. Miss it and the seats are gone.
build: An agent that waits until 10:00, books, pays and sends the ticket (mock the booking site).
kill_test: Kill it at 09:59. Kill it again after payment.
must_hold: It still books at 10:00. One ticket, one payment.

title: Group trip: all or nothing
situation: Eight friends need a train, a hotel and a cab. If the hotel fails, the train should be cancelled too.
build: An agent that books all three and undoes what it booked if one fails.
kill_test: Kill it after the train is booked and before the hotel.
must_hold: Either everything is booked or everything is cancelled. Nothing paid twice.

title: Flight cancelled: rebook 50 people
situation: A flight is cancelled. 50 passengers need a new flight or a hotel, and each one chooses.
build: An agent that offers options to each passenger, waits for replies and books.
kill_test: Kill it halfway through the passengers.
must_hold: Each passenger rebooked once. Pending replies still pending.

title: Hotel pre-check-in
situation: A hotel collects ID, payment and preferences over WhatsApp before arrival. Guests reply hours apart.
build: A chat agent that collects it all across days.
must_hold: It never asks a question the guest already answered.

title: Visa tracker
situation: A visa: fill the form, book a slot, wait weeks for a decision, send documents when asked.
build: An agent that tracks one application end to end.
kill_test: Kill it during the weeks-long wait (1 day = 1 minute).
must_hold: Still waiting. The history shows every step.

title: Hold a bus seat for 10 minutes
situation: A seat is held while the customer pays. If they don't, it goes back on sale.
build: An agent with a 10-minute hold.
must_hold: The seat is either sold once or released once.

title: Darshan slots for a family
situation: Temple darshan slots open monthly and sell out in minutes. A family of six needs them together.
build: An agent that books six slots, pays and sends the tickets.
must_hold: One payment, six tickets.

title: 4 AM airport cab
situation: Booked the night before. At 3:30 the driver has to confirm or someone has to find another.
build: An agent that schedules the cab, checks at 3:30 and escalates if there's no driver.
must_hold: The 3:30 check still happens.

title: Cancelled trip: three refunds
situation: Airline, hotel and cab each refund on their own timeline: days to weeks.
build: An agent that requests all three and follows up until each arrives.
must_hold: Each refund requested once. The log shows which arrived when.

title: Corporate travel approval
situation: Manager approves every trip; finance also approves above ₹50,000; then it's booked.
build: An agent that runs the approvals and books.
kill_test: Kill it between the two approvals.
must_hold: Approvals aren't asked again. Booked once.

title: Clinic appointments
situation: A clinic books slots, reminds patients a day before and marks no-shows.
build: An agent that does all three.
kill_test: Kill it between the booking and the reminder.
must_hold: One reminder, on time.

title: Lab report follow-up
situation: A blood sample takes hours to days. Critical values must reach the doctor fast.
build: An agent that waits for the lab, sends the report and alerts the doctor for critical values.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the lab.
must_hold: The report is sent once. Critical alerts are never missed.

title: Monthly medicine refill
situation: A diabetic patient needs the same medicines every month. Some need a pharmacist's approval.
build: An agent that checks stock, waits for the pharmacist, charges and delivers.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the pharmacist.
must_hold: Charged once, delivered once.

title: Hospital discharge
situation: Discharge needs billing, pharmacy and insurance. Insurance approval takes hours.
build: An agent that coordinates the three and tells the family where things stand.
kill_test: Kill it while insurance is pending.
must_hold: No department is asked twice. The family sees the true status.

title: Insurance claim
situation: A health claim: submit documents, answer queries over weeks, get settled.
build: An agent that runs one claim end to end.
kill_test: Kill it during a query wait.
must_hold: Resumes at the open query. Full history of the claim.

title: Blood donation drive
situation: 500 donors to message, slots to book, reminders to send.
build: An agent that does it.
must_hold: Each donor messaged once.

title: Newborn vaccination schedule
situation: Vaccines are due over 18 months. Parents forget.
build: An agent that reminds parents on each due date.
kill_test: Kill it, then restart it 'three months later' (1 month = 1 minute).
must_hold: The next reminder is the right one, on the right date.

title: Ambulance dispatch
situation: An ambulance is assigned; if the driver doesn't accept in 2 minutes, reassign.
build: A dispatch agent with a full log.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the driver.
must_hold: One ambulance per call. Every assignment logged.

title: Doctor-approved medicine order
situation: Some orders need the doctor to say yes on their phone first.
build: An agent that drafts the order, waits for the doctor, then orders.
must_hold: Ordered once, only after a yes.

title: Teleconsult follow-up
situation: After a video consult: send the prescription, book a follow-up in 7 days.
build: An agent that does both.
kill_test: Kill it right after the consult ends.
must_hold: One prescription, one follow-up.

title: Monthly GST filing
situation: Collect invoices all month, prepare the return, the CA approves, file before the 20th.
build: An agent that runs the month (mock the GST portal).
kill_test: Kill it after filing and before the acknowledgement is saved.
must_hold: Filed once. The acknowledgement is recovered, not refiled.

title: KYC onboarding
situation: PAN, Aadhaar, a video KYC slot, then an officer verifies.
build: An agent that runs KYC for one customer (mock everything).
kill_test: Kill it between the video slot and the officer's check.
must_hold: No step redone. The officer's decision is recorded.

title: Passport appointment watcher
situation: Appointment slots open at random times.
build: An agent that checks every hour and books the first slot.
must_hold: Checks continue on schedule. One booking.

title: Property tax for a society
situation: 120 flats; the society pays each flat's property tax and collects receipts.
build: An agent that pays all 120.
must_hold: 120 payments, 120 receipts.

title: RTI tracker
situation: An RTI must be answered in 30 days; if not, file a first appeal.
build: An agent that files, waits and appeals.
must_hold: The appeal is filed on day 31, once.

title: Compliance calendar
situation: TDS, ROC and GST deadlines. A director has to sign some of them.
build: An agent that prepares each filing, reminds, and waits for the signature.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for a signature.
must_hold: No deadline missed. The log shows who signed when.

title: Electricity bill dispute
situation: A wrong bill. The complaint needs follow-up every week until it's fixed.
build: An agent that raises it and follows up.
must_hold: One follow-up per week, not one per restart.

title: Income tax refund tracker
situation: Refunds take weeks.
build: An agent that checks weekly and tells you when it lands.
must_hold: Checks continue weekly. One notification.

title: Scholarship application
situation: A student uploads documents; the college verifies; then the government approves.
build: An agent that runs the application end to end.
kill_test: Kill it while the college verifies.
must_hold: No re-upload asked. The history shows each approval.

title: Land record mutation
situation: Several offices sign off over months.
build: An agent that tracks each office and chases them.
kill_test: Kill it at any step a judge picks.
must_hold: It resumes at that step. Every sign-off recorded.

title: Deploy with rollback
situation: Build, migrate the database, deploy, smoke test; roll back on failure.
build: A deploy agent.
kill_test: Kill it after the migration ran.
must_hold: The migration runs once. The app is either deployed or rolled back.

title: On-call agent
situation: An alert fires. Gather logs, page the on-call, escalate if there's no ack in 10 minutes.
build: An incident agent.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the ack.
must_hold: The escalation still fires on time, once.

title: Migrate 10 million rows
situation: A backfill over 10M rows in batches.
build: A migration agent.
must_hold: Every row migrated exactly once. It resumes at the right batch.

title: PR review bot
situation: A bot that reviews pull requests with an LLM.
build: A review agent (a local git repo is fine).
kill_test: Kill it halfway through posting comments.
must_hold: No duplicate comments.

title: Coding agent vs laptop shutdown
situation: A long refactor across 20 files dies when the laptop sleeps.
build: A coding agent that edits files one by one.
must_hold: It resumes at file 10. No file edited twice. No LLM call repeated.

title: Certificate renewals
situation: 50 domains, renew each TLS cert 30 days before expiry.
build: A renewal agent (mock the CA).
must_hold: Each cert renewed once.

title: Give me my data (DPDP)
situation: A user asks for their data. Collect from 5 services, send a link, delete the export after 7 days.
build: An export agent.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits out the 7 days.
must_hold: The export is deleted on day 7, once. Every step logged.

title: Delete my account
situation: A 30-day grace period, cancelled if the user logs in, then delete everywhere.
build: A deletion agent.
kill_test: Kill it during the grace period.
must_hold: Deleted once after 30 days, or not at all if they logged in.

title: Nightly pipeline
situation: A 6-step data pipeline that restarts from step 1 when it fails.
build: A pipeline that resumes.
must_hold: It resumes at step 4.

title: Cloud cost cleanup
situation: Find idle VMs, ask the owner, wait 3 days, shut down.
build: A cleanup agent (mock the cloud).
must_hold: Each VM shut down once, only after the wait.

title: Interview scheduler
situation: Three interviewers and a candidate, all busy.
build: An agent that finds a slot and sends one invite.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for replies.
must_hold: One invite per person.

title: Employee onboarding
situation: Laptop, email account, payroll and a welcome kit, spread over a week.
build: An onboarding agent.
must_hold: One laptop ordered, one account, one kit.

title: Offer letter
situation: HR, finance and the CEO approve; the candidate has 7 days to accept.
build: An offer agent.
kill_test: Kill it between approvals and during the 7 days.
must_hold: One offer sent. The deadline still holds.

title: Leave approval
situation: A leave request waits for the manager.
build: A leave agent.
must_hold: Still waiting. The decision is recorded.

title: Full and final settlement
situation: Collect the laptop, compute dues, pay.
build: An exit agent.
must_hold: Paid once.

title: Shift roster
situation: A factory publishes a roster; people request swaps; the supervisor approves.
build: A roster agent.
must_hold: Pending swaps survive. Every change logged.

title: Background verification
situation: Ask three previous employers; they take up to 2 weeks.
build: A verification agent that chases them.
must_hold: No employer asked twice.

title: Screen 2,000 resumes
situation: An LLM scores each resume. That costs money.
build: A screening agent.
must_hold: It resumes at 1,001. No resume scored twice.

title: Arrears after a raise
situation: 200 people got a backdated raise. Compute, approve, pay.
build: An arrears agent.
must_hold: Each person paid once. Approval recorded.

title: Campus hiring
situation: 500 students: test, results, interviews.
build: A hiring-drive agent.
must_hold: Each student gets one result.

title: Assignment grading
situation: 300 submissions, graded by an LLM.
build: A grading agent.
must_hold: Nothing graded twice.

title: Fee reminders and late fee
situation: Three reminders, then a late fee.
build: A fee agent.
must_hold: The late fee is added once.

title: Admissions
situation: Apply, check documents, test, offer, pay the fee by a deadline.
build: An admissions agent.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the fee.
must_hold: The seat is released if the deadline passes, once.

title: Publish exam results
situation: 5,000 students, one SMS each.
build: A results agent.
must_hold: Each student gets one SMS.

title: Workshop certificates
situation: Certificates for everyone who attended (try it on today's attendees).
build: A certificate agent.
must_hold: One email per person.

title: Library overdue
situation: A book is due; remind, then fine.
build: A library agent.
must_hold: Reminders on schedule.

title: Parent-teacher meetings
situation: 40 parents, 1 teacher, 15-minute slots.
build: A scheduling agent.
must_hold: No slot double-booked.

title: Course coach
situation: Nudge learners over weeks based on their progress.
build: A coaching agent.
must_hold: No nudge repeated or skipped.

title: Scholarship payout
situation: Approved students get paid; a committee approves the list.
build: A payout agent.
must_hold: Each student paid once.

title: Hostel rooms
situation: Students list preferences; rooms are allocated; pay in 48 hours or lose it.
build: An allocation agent.
must_hold: Each room given once.

title: Failed delivery retries
situation: Retry the next day, up to 3 times, then return to sender.
build: A delivery agent.
must_hold: One attempt per day.

title: Truck trip tracker
situation: A 3-day trip, checkpoints, delay alerts, proof of delivery.
build: A trip agent.
must_hold: No alert repeated. Full trip history.

title: Warehouse pick and pack
situation: Pick items for an order, pack, label.
build: A picking agent.
must_hold: No item picked twice.

title: Purchase order approvals
situation: Department head, then finance.
build: A PO agent.
must_hold: Each approval asked once.

title: Cold chain alert
situation: A vaccine fridge gets too warm. Alert, wait for an ack, escalate.
build: An alerting agent.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for the ack.
must_hold: The escalation still happens.

title: Pay the vendor on delivery
situation: Pay only after the warehouse confirms receipt.
build: A vendor-payment agent.
kill_test: Kill it after confirmation, before payment.
must_hold: Paid once.

title: Field technician
situation: Assign a job, wait for the completion photo, close it.
build: A dispatch agent.
kill_test: Kill it while the job is open.
must_hold: Still open after restart.

title: Crop advisory
situation: Weekly advice for a season, plus alerts when the weather turns.
build: An advisory agent.
must_hold: Each week's advice sent once.

title: Mandi price alert
situation: A farmer wants to sell when onion hits a target price.
build: A price-watch agent.
must_hold: One alert when the price is hit.

title: Water tanker for a society
situation: Book a tanker when the tank level drops.
build: A tanker agent.
must_hold: One tanker per drop.

title: Apartment maintenance
situation: 200 flats, monthly dues, reminders, a late fee.
build: A maintenance agent.
must_hold: One late fee per flat.

title: Visitor approval
situation: The guard asks the resident; no reply in 5 minutes means no entry.
build: A gate agent.
must_hold: The timeout still fires.

title: Meetup organiser
situation: RSVPs, a waitlist, reminders, certificates after (think AI Yatra).
build: An event agent.
must_hold: No double seats. One reminder each.

title: Wedding vendors
situation: Caterer, decorator, venue. Payments in milestones. The family approves each.
build: A wedding agent.
must_hold: Each milestone paid once.

title: SIP rebalancer
situation: Rebalance monthly, but only after you say yes.
build: A finance agent.
kill_test: Kill it while it waits for you.
must_hold: Rebalanced once per month.

title: Bill pay
situation: Electricity, mobile and gas every month.
build: A bill agent.
must_hold: Each bill paid once.

title: Medicine reminder for a parent
situation: Remind; if there's no reply in 30 minutes, call family.
build: A reminder agent.
must_hold: The family is still called on time.

title: Volunteer roster
situation: A temple or NGO event needs 50 volunteers across shifts.
build: A roster agent.
must_hold: No shift double-booked.

title: Medical crowdfunding
situation: Collect donations; pay the hospital when the target is reached.
build: A fundraising agent.
kill_test: Kill it when the target is hit.
must_hold: The hospital is paid once. Every donation is recorded.

title: Your own agent
situation: Bring any agent you already use or built.
build: Make it survive a kill -9.
kill_test: Kill it wherever the judges point.
must_hold: It finishes, with nothing done twice.
